title: Relay frame size check
responsibility: Determines whether a text or binary frame exceeds the byte limit.

inputs.name: frameTooLarge.message
inputs.description: Text frame or binary ArrayBuffer. Text is measured as UTF-8 bytes.

inputs.name: frameTooLarge.limit
inputs.description: Optional byte limit, defaulting to the protocol’s 262,144 bytes.

outputs.name: frameTooLarge
outputs.description: True only when frame bytes exceed the limit; equal size is accepted. Text-length bounds avoid encoding when the answer is already certain.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: A missing required runtime object fails property access.
